compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- DD3: New module plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/arbiter_processor.py with process_rulings(rulings, finding_map, cycle_num, commit_sha, pr_number=None, branch_name=None, ticket_cmd_path='.claude/scripts/dso') returning {"block": [...], "defer_ticket_ids": [...], "drop_defense_records": [...], "skipped_idempotent": [...]}.
- DD6 (test side): arbiter-rulings.json sidecar atomic write with schema_version 1.0.0

## TDD Requirement
Write failing tests in tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_arbiter_processor.py covering:

1. test_process_rulings_accumulates_block
   - Given: rulings list with 2 BLOCK + 1 DROP
   - When: process_rulings called
   - Then: result["block"] has 2 entries with finding metadata

2. test_process_rulings_defer_creates_orphan_ticket
   - Given: ruling with ruling=DEFER + finding_map with finding details
   - When: process_rulings called with PR_NUMBER=42, mocked TICKET_CMD returning "t-new-001"
   - Then: TICKET_CMD invoked with "create task" containing "Deferred review finding:", --tags=orphan:deferred_review, --tags=origin:arbiter, --priority=3
   - AND result["defer_ticket_ids"] contains "t-new-001"

3. test_process_rulings_defer_idempotent_skips_existing_ticket
   - Given: ruling with ruling=DEFER for finding_hash that already has an orphan ticket on this PR
   - When: process_rulings called twice with same finding+PR
   - Then: ticket create is invoked ONCE; second call finds existing ticket via query and returns it
   - AND result["skipped_idempotent"] contains the finding_hash for second call

4. test_process_rulings_drop_writes_dual_store_when_pr_number_set
   - Given: ruling with ruling=DROP, PR_NUMBER=42
   - When: process_rulings called
   - Then: both review-defense-store.sh AND review-github-defense-store.sh subprocess calls observed (mocked)
   - AND defense_type="dropped_by_arbiter" in both writes

5. test_process_rulings_drop_skips_pr_store_when_pr_number_absent
   - Given: ruling with ruling=DROP, PR_NUMBER=None (local mode), branch_name="story/x"
   - When: process_rulings called
   - Then: only review-defense-store.sh called (tracker); review-github-defense-store.sh NOT called

6. test_process_rulings_writes_arbiter_rulings_sidecar
   - Given: rulings list with mixed BLOCK/DEFER/DROP
   - When: process_rulings called with artifacts_dir=tmp_path
   - Then: arbiter-rulings.json sidecar file is written atomically to tmp_path with schema_version=1.0.0, commit_sha, cycle_num, rulings array, summary {block_count, defer_count, drop_count}

7. test_process_rulings_sidecar_overwrite_idempotent_on_same_sha
   - Given: process_rulings called twice with same commit_sha + same rulings
   - Then: sidecar content is byte-identical between writes (no duplication)

8. test_process_rulings_defer_dedup_uses_finding_hash_plus_pr_in_description
   - Given: a DEFER ruling; ticket query mock returns existing ticket whose description contains the marker "Finding-Hash: <hash> Scope: #42"
   - When: process_rulings called for same finding_hash + PR=42
   - Then: dedup hits; new ticket NOT created; existing ID returned in result

All tests must FAIL (ModuleNotFoundError) before T4 implementation runs. Use mocks for TICKET_CMD subprocess and defense store subprocess calls. Update .test-index with RED marker.

## Implementation Notes
- Test file: tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_arbiter_processor.py
- Import: from dso_ci_review.arbiter_processor import process_rulings
- Use unittest.mock.patch for subprocess.run patches
- Use tmp_path fixture for sidecar atomic-write tests
- Each test should be standalone — minimal coupling between tests

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] test_arbiter_processor.py exists with 8 test functions
  Verify: grep -c "^def test_" \$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_arbiter_processor.py | awk '{exit (\$1 < 8)}'
- [ ] All 8 tests FAIL with ModuleNotFoundError
  Verify: python -m pytest \$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_arbiter_processor.py 2>&1 | grep -qE "8 (errors|failed)|ModuleNotFoundError"
- [ ] .test-index updated
  Verify: grep "test_process_rulings_accumulates_block\|arbiter_processor" \$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
